function: Gridless estimation of the spatial frequencies and Doppler of the UAV-RIS cascaded mmWave channel with low pilot overhead, via unfolded ADMM networks (p. 1, 3).
system: Single-antenna transmitter, NRX-antenna ULA receiver (8-128 antennas), passive reflecting UAV-RIS with 8x8 UPA (64 elements), mmWave 28 GHz, UAV 20 km/h (p. 1, 4).
method: Deep unfolding of ADMM (DADU-Net) with trainable mu1, mu2, rho per layer and spectral shift; fixed-point extension DADF-Net; supervised training, weighted MSE loss, Adam (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom simulated Saleh-Valenzuela channel with Doppler, Rician K 20 dB, L of 1 or 3, random angles; synthetic training sets of 2e5 or 1e6 samples (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Training (Table II): SNR 0 dB, MP=16. Testing (Figs. 3-4): SNR 0-10 dB, MP 16-96, runtime for 64-576 RIS elements, same synthetic model; retraining not stated (p. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: decoupled 1D-SDP and 2D-SDP (atomic norm minimization). Learned: LMMSE-CNN, ResU-Net, GDDU (gradient-descent unfolding) (p. 4-5).
metrics: MSE of spatial-frequency estimation (Figs. 3-4) and runtime in seconds (Table I in ms) versus SNR, pilots, RIS elements, network depth (p. 4-5).
complexity: Measured runtime only: DADU-Net over an order of magnitude faster than SDP (Fig. 3(b)); Table I end-to-end runtime 6.84 ms (Frobenius norm) vs 15.05-15.43 ms (CNN) (p. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 2: "we adopt the Saleh-Valenzuela channel model as [15]"; p. 4: footnote 5 says only that the method "is also applicable to more complex models such as QuaDRiGa [23]". Custom simulator, no 3GPP model or measured data used.
q2_support: p. 4: "The training parameters for the proposed method, based on the loss function in (18), are summarized in Table II." It lists SNR 0 dB and MP 16; the paper never states that a trained model is tested on unseen conditions or adapted. SNR sweeps do not count.
q3_support: p. 4: "off-grid channel estimation algorithms, including decoupled 1D-SDP [4] and decoupled 2D-SDP [5]" (MSE, Fig. 3(a)); p. 5: "is compared with deep learning-based approaches", "ResU-Net [8], and GDDU [12]" (MSE, Fig. 4(a),(b)).
q4_support: p. 4: "while reducing runtime by more than an order of magnitude, as shown in Fig. 3(b)"; Table I (p. 4) gives measured runtime in ms (6.84 for the Frobenius-norm DADU-Net).
q5_support: p. 4: "This section presents simulation results evaluating MSE and runtime"; data come from its own simulator (p. 2, Eq. 2) and no code or data link is given; the only URLs are CVX [18] and QuaDRiGa [23].
notes: Function is borderline: the networks output spatial frequencies (AoA, RIS angles with Doppler) and the effective channel matrix, and the MSE is on spatial frequencies. The paper frames it as RIS channel estimation (title and abstract, p. 1), so area 2, not DoA alone and not area 6 (aerial link but no power, resource or beam control). q2 is borderline: Table II (p. 4) lists training SNR 0 dB and MP 16, while Fig. 4(a) uses MP = 64 and Fig. 4(b) sweeps MP 16-96, but the paper does not say whether networks were retrained per setting, so q2 = 0 under the explicit-statement rule; reviewer to confirm.
